content:
meera: FYI onboarding is broken — new hires from Okta aren't getting created in Redwood. Noticed several JIT failures tonight.
jonathan: any error logs?
meera: from the SCIM webhook -> our backend returns 422. snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
{
  "detail": "Unrecognized attribute: entitlements",
  "status": 422
}
```
meera: payload Okta sent:
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "j.smith@company.com",
  "name": {"givenName": "John", "familyName": "Smith"},
  "entitlements": ["engineering","oncall"]
}
```
alex: looks like our SCIM handler expects `roles` not `entitlements`. Okta attribute mapping maybe set to `entitlements`. JIT path uses SAML attrs to create the initial profile which then triggers SCIM sync.
sam: also saw SAML assertion missing `email` in a few cases — JIT will bail if the `login` mapping isn't present.
meera: SAML sample from the failing assertion:
```
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="firstName"><saml:AttributeValue>John</saml:AttributeValue></saml:Attribute>
  <saml:Attribute Name="lastName"><saml:AttributeValue>Smith</saml:AttributeValue></saml:Attribute>
  <!-- email/userName missing for these users -->
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```
alex: confirm Okta app has `userName` mapped to `Email` and that profile attr `entitlements` is mapped to our SCIM `roles` attribute. We recently changed the app mapping in Okta during the last admin cleanup.
security-bot: audit log entry: "SCIM_CREATE_FAILED" user=j.smith@company.com reason=unrecognized_attribute entitlements provider=okta ts=2026-03-14T02:13:09Z
meera: one more wrinkle — when SCIM tries to store the service token we encrypt it with the KMS key. I'm seeing intermittent KMS failures around the same time:
```
ERROR kms: AccessDenied: User arn:aws:iam::99999:role/redwood-scim-svc can't call kms:GenerateDataKey on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:99999:key/abcd-ef01
```
sam: that would cause retries and timeouts back to Okta, making the provisioning look flaky. Did we rotate the key policy recently?
meera: yes, ops rotated the key last week and added a new alias. I think the role ARN wasn't added to the key policy.
jonathan: plan:
1) temporarily disable JIT in the Okta app so Okta falls back to manual invites and to stop failing creations.
2) patch Okta->SCIM attribute mapping: map `entitlements` -> `roles` (or accept both keys in our SCIM handler)
3) update KMS key policy to include `arn:aws:iam::99999:role/redwood-scim-svc`
4) re-enable JIT and monitor for new failures
alex: adding a quick mitigation — I'll make the SCIM receiver tolerant: accept `entitlements` as alias for `roles` and log a warning instead of 422.
meera: creating PR and Okta ticket. If anyone has access to the key policy can you add the role? tagging @devops for help.
devops-bot: deploy bot: rolling patch to SCIM service (canary) started — 3 nodes
jonathan: once patched we'll also re-run the failing onboarding jobs for the affected users and verify audit logs show successful creation and KMS encrypt successes.
meera: thanks all. I'll update the thread when Okta JIT is re-enabled or if we need to roll back. :eyes:
